title: Does not refresh on widget
body: I use this all the time and I use its widget. I need to it to be up to date when I modify it or complete a task. I sometimes use it on my PC yet when I check the widget on my phone it is almost never synced with the most recent info. I have to open and refresh it myself every time.
author: Ghun2323

title: Helpful
body: It was so helpful for all my school work I knew exactly what to do next
